definitions.gloss: old traditional Japanese house, old folk house
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese residential house, typically built before the mid-20th century using traditional construction methods. Many have been preserved, relocated, or renovated as cafes, inns, or cultural facilities.

examples.japanese: {古民家|こみんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They renovated an old traditional house into a cafe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{古民家|こみんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りて→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I rent an old traditional house in the countryside and live there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古民家|こみんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}→宿泊施設：16474_shukuhakushisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Recently, projects to restore old traditional houses and turn them into lodging facilities are advancing in various areas.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧ (old) + ⟦{民家|みんか}→民家：13217_minka⟧ (private house). These houses feature traditional elements like ⟦{土間|どま}→土間：07849_doma⟧ (earthen floor), ⟦{囲炉裏|いろり}→囲炉裏：12008_irori⟧ (traditional hearth), exposed beams ({梁|はり}), and thatched roofs (⟦{茅葺|かやぶ}き→茅葺き：27791_kayabuki⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧). In recent years, {古民家|こみんか} renovation has become a popular trend in rural revitalization.
